sahneler.metin: Near Novorossiysk, a bulk carrier rammed the Soviet liner Admiral Nakhimov.
It sank within minutes, and four hundred twenty three people died.
A pilot radioed a warning to the freighter.
The freighter didn't slow or turn.
The liner's captain had gone to his cabin.
The officers exchanged radio calls, but it was too late.
Both captains were sentenced to fifteen years.

aciklama:
Admiral Nakhimov sank after a collision near Novorossiysk. The cause: collision after both captains violated navigation rules and assumed the other would give way.
